senses.gloss:
सौवीर(क)
See कर्कन्धू̆, कोल, बदर.
(1) ZIZYPHUS SATIVA GAERTN. (Dgv, nr. 84, = राजकोल = राज-
बदर; V 1, p. 163) = Z. VULGARIS LAM. (Dgv, nr. 84; V 1, p. 163);
(2) a) = कोल (HK);
b) = बृहद्बदर (Vśs);
J. J. Meyer, transl. Kauṭ., p. 141, note 8: Gaṇ. explains that कोल
is the small, बदर the large and सौवीरक the sweet jujube. Ḍa. on
Su.Sū. 46, 139: बदर is large, कोल is of a moderate size and कर्कन्धु
is small; सौवीर is the largest (among the jujube-fruits) and is, both
ripe and unripe, sweet.
